title: Board LODs, Grid Snap, and SVG Icons
description: Board: four discrete LODs (minimap/overview/normal/detail) with configurable zoom thresholds as props; per-LOD grid (none / 10 / 10+5 / 10+5+1), node stroke/fill, edge weight, handles, labels vs abbreviated vs vello_svg icons; grid snap to visible grid lines with toolbar toggle; integrate vello_svg for detail node icons from metabolism example SVGs.
summary: Extended board LODs from four bands to five by adding a micro tier and detailMaxZoom threshold in TypeScript and the Rust/WASM host. Updated LOD resolution, default thresholds, overlay caption policy, and grid math to match the new spec: minimap none, overview 100, normal 100+25, detail 100+25+5, micro 100+25+5+1. Rust draw logic now renders node icons in detail+micro, handle icons only in micro, keeps minimap outline-free with stroke-colored fills, and snaps to the finest visible grid per tier. Extended board tests for five-band threshold resolution and caption behavior. Validation: focused Vitest on elements/client/lib/board/index.ts passed 42 tests; cargo test --manifest-path elements/client/lib/board/rs/Cargo.toml passed 31 tests.
